Regret not returning
Mar 2024 • Solo
Found this place on trip advisor while hold up in a hotel 5 minutes away. Very friendly chef/owner took the time to talk to me as I gave him background on my pizza experience hailing from the Italian neighborhoods of Boston & Providence. Ended up trying three pies, Potato/bacon which I call Irish, Salami, and Hawaiian. The crust was really good. The Irish was my favorite. Salami unfortunately was tough and chewy. Hawaiian was great, bacon not ham. Bacon was actually cooked on these pizzas which was a bonus as Thais & Vietnamese serve bacon raw which drives me insane. I had intended to return to try the deep dish but never made it. A regular pizza here is a one person pizza for $5.00 bucks. That’s a great deal. Recommend.
